an-angler-s-guesthouse-where-the-ume-riv: An angler's guesthouse where the Ume River meets Lake Storuman. Char, trout, grayling and whitefish, five minutes from the door.
big-char-wild-trout-and-clear-northern-w: Big char, wild trout and clear northern water
slussfors-sits-where-the-ume-river-runs: Slussfors sits where the Ume River runs into Lake Storuman. The Kirjesån stream, known for its trout, joins the river just around the corner from the house, and the lakes Järvsjön, Magasjön and Boksjön are a short drive away.
the-secret-is-the-char-farm-just-below-t: One reason for the exceptional fishing is the char farm in Sparmanselet, about 4 km upstream from the house (★ on the map). It adds nutrients to the water, which helps keep many large char and whitefish in a small area, summer and winter. It is a big part of what brings anglers from far away.
lake-storuman-and-part-of-the-ume-river: Lake Storuman and part of the Ume River. Char, trout, grayling and whitefish.
the-kirjes-n-stream-and-lake-nedre-lumni: The Kirjesån stream and Lake Nedre Lumnien. Mostly trout, with grayling and rainbow trout near the river mouth.
buy-the-licence-on-your-phone-before-you: Buy the licence on your phone before you cast, and check rules and size limits on the same page. Prices as listed on iFiske in November 2026.
we-do-not-rent-out-a-boat-ourselves-boat: We do not rent out a boat ourselves. Boats with or without motor can be rented locally: ask the Slussfors fishing association, contact Daniel Bergfors, +46 730 26 68 71, or look for private boats in Storuman municipality on Hygglo. You can also ask at the village shop Slussforsboa, +46 951 501 70. There is a public boat ramp in the village, and fuel is sold at the village petrol station.
the-star-of-slussfors-troll-or-jig-in-su: The star of Slussfors. Best through the ice from February to April, when the days are long and bright, and by boat from June to September. Try trolling or jigging in summer.
wild-trout-in-the-kirjes-n-stream-own-li: Wild trout in the Kirjesån stream (own licence, see above) and the river. Best from June to September: fly, spinner or a quiet drift at dusk in midsummer.
the-lady-of-the-stream-with-her-purple-s: The "lady of the stream", with her purple sail fin. Best from June to October, when she rises to small dry flies in the river currents.
very-large-whitefish-are-caught-through: Best through the ice from January to April, and in open water from June to August. Very large whitefish take small jigs on light line, so bring patience for a sunny March day.
our-rough-guide-ice-and-seasons-vary-fro: Our rough guide. Ice and seasons vary from year to year, and the licence page has the rules that apply.
a-good-day-on-the-ice: A good day on the ice
on-the-blue-highway-in-the-middle-of-the: On the Blue Highway, in the middle of the water
slussfors-lies-on-the-e12-between-storum: Slussfors lies on the E12 between Storuman and the mountains. Switch between the nearby fishing waters and the wider region, and tap a place to fly there.
distances-are-straight-line-from-the-hou: Distances are straight-line from the house. Drive times are approximate.
warm-simple-and-made-for-long-days-outdo: Warm, simple and made for long days outdoors
80-m-with-a-fully-equipped-kitchen-a-liv: 80 m² with a fully equipped kitchen, a living room with an open fireplace and a big TV, and two bedrooms. Dry your gear, light the fire, and smoke today's catch in the brick smoker in the yard.
the-house-is-one-half-of-a-semi-detached: The house is one half of a semi-detached building with its own entrance, its own yard and plenty of parking for cars, boats and trailers. A groomed exercise trail of about 2.5 km for walking and skiing starts right behind the house.

plenty-of-parking-on-the-property-for-se: Plenty of parking on the property for several cars, boats and trailers, free of charge.
public-boat-ramp-in-slussfors-about-2-km: Public boat ramp in Slussfors, about 2 km from the house.
fuel-and-groceries-in-the-village-a-few: Fuel and groceries in the village, a few minutes away.
light-all-night-then-snow-and-northern-l: Light all night, then snow and northern lights
hike-pick-berries-and-mushrooms-play-dis: Hike, pick berries and mushrooms, play disc golf, and fish late into the bright night.
ice-fishing-for-char-and-whitefish-ski-t: Ice fishing for char and whitefish, ski the trail behind the house, and watch for aurora on clear nights.
hemavan-t-rnaby-and-kittelfj-ll-are-abou: Tärnaby (about 50 min), Kittelfjäll (about 1 h) and Hemavan (about 1 h 10 min) offer alpine skiing and high-fell hiking. Reindeer may pass the house.
rating-score: 4.74out of 5 from 19 guest reviews · we usually reply within an hour

self-catering-you-clean-before-you-leave: Self-catering: you clean before you leave, so there is no cleaning fee. Bed linen and towels are not included. Bring your own or add them below.
send-your-dates-with-the-form-the-price: Send your dates with the form. The price estimate updates as you type.
we-reply-within-24-hours-with-a-confirma: We reply within 24 hours with a confirmation and a secure PayPal request for a €100 deposit.
pay-by-credit-or-debit-card-or-with-your: Pay by credit or debit card, or with your PayPal account. You do not need a PayPal account to pay by card. Your dates are booked when the deposit is received. The rest is paid 30 days before arrival, or all at once if you book later than that. Free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival with everything refunded, including the deposit. Later cancellations are not refunded.
before-arrival-you-get-the-key-box-code: Before arrival you get the key box code and our local fishing tips.
no-booking-platform-in-between-you-talk: No booking platform in between: you talk to us, the owners. Nothing is charged when you send a request.
bed-linen-and-towels-or-add-them-to-your: Bed linen and towels (or add them to your request, 200 SEK per person), and of course your fishing gear. Duvets and pillows are in the house.
yes-pets-are-welcome-please-keep-them-of: Yes, pets are welcome. Please keep them off the beds and sofas.
there-is-a-grocery-shop-slussforsboa-46: There is a grocery shop, Slussforsboa (+46 951 501 70), and a fuel station in the village. Opening hours are limited, so call or check before you arrive. The nearest larger town, Storuman, is about 45 minutes by car.
yes-free-of-charge-up-to-30-days-before: Yes, free of charge up to 30 days before arrival, and you get everything back, including the €100 deposit. If you cancel later than that, the payment is not refunded.
when-can-we-arrive-and-leave: When can we arrive and leave?
check-in-from-14-00-and-check-out-by-12: Check-in from 14:00 and check-out by 12:00, with self check-in through a key box.
is-there-room-for-our-boat-and-trailer: Is there room for our boat and trailer?
yes-there-is-plenty-of-free-parking-on-t: Yes. There is plenty of free parking on the property for cars, boats and trailers, and the public boat ramp in Slussfors is about 2 km away.
we-do-not-rent-out-a-boat-ourselves-boat: We do not rent out a boat ourselves. Boats can be rented locally, see "Boats" under The fishing for where to ask. There is a public boat ramp in Slussfors if you bring your own.
add-bed-linen-and-towels-200-sek-per-per: Add bed linen and towels (200 SEK per person)

real-catches-p: Summer 2025 and 2026, all a short drive from the house.
real-big-char: Big char · by the char farm
bait-tackle-p: Worms and maggots are usually sold at the village shop Slussforsboa, a few minutes from the house, along with a small range of fishing tackle.
faq-platform-q: Can we book through a booking platform instead?
faq-platform-a: Yes, you can also find us on Airbnb and Booking.com.
shore-or-boat-p: You can fish from shore at the point by the bridge near the char farm, at the river outlet close to the house and along the Kirjesån stream. A boat is an advantage outside the char farm, in the middle of the river, in Rännan and in the deep part of Järvsjön. Boat launches: Slussfors, Järvsjön and Magasjön. The small dots on the map show each spot.
smoker-freezer-p: The brick smoker in the yard is free to use, just bring your own wood. There is a freezer indoors for your catch, and in winter the fish keep well outside in boxes, since it is well below freezing.
